references.context: Vertex set has at least one element and finitely many vertices.

references.phrase: least positive k admitting proper coloring
references.context: Minimum of admissible palette sizes over all functions assigning distinct labels to adjacent vertices.

references.phrase: not exact number of used colors
references.disposition: Existence of a proper k-coloring does not require all k labels to appear; minimal k is the chromatic number.

review_rationale: Reviewed chromatic number for finite nonempty loopless simple graph as smallest admissible positive k of a proper vertex coloring; palette usage need not be surjective.
